meta.name: pragmatic-programmer
meta.description: Apply meta-principles of software craftsmanship: DRY, orthogonality, tracer bullets, and design by contract. Use when the user mentions "best practices", "pragmatic approach", "broken windows", "tracer bullet", "software craftsmanship", "avoid technical debt", "code ownership", or "how do I become a better developer". Also trigger when evaluating build-vs-buy decisions, designing estimation approaches, or choosing between reversible and irreversible architectural decisions. Covers estimation, domain languages, and reversibility. For code-level quality, see clean-code. For refactoring techniques, see refactoring-patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 应用软件工艺原则提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Apply software craftsmanship principles to improve code quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to apply software craftsmanship best practices in daily development

howto.what: Claude 会运用软件工艺的元原则（如 DRY、正交性、曳光弹、契约式设计）来评估和改进你的代码、架构或工程实践。它会给出 10 分制的评分，指出违反的原则，并给出具体修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“最佳实践”、“务实方法”、“破窗”、“曳光弹”、“软件工艺”、“避免技术债务”、“代码所有权”或“如何成为更好的开发者”等关键词时触发。也适用于评估自建 vs 购买、设计估算方法或选择可逆/不可逆架构决策时。

say.text: 帮我检查这段代码有没有违反 DRY 原则。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码中的知识重复，并给出合并建议。

say.text: 这个架构设计正交性如何？
say.note: Claude 会评估组件间的耦合度，并建议解耦方式。

say.text: 用曳光弹方法规划这个新项目。
say.note: Claude 会建议一个端到端的极简实现路径。
